title: A non-empty VITEST in the bot environment or .env switched a real start to test behaviour: a temporary database with no open positions, and every Telegram alert refused, while the bot kept trading
severity_rationale: S2, equal to the estimate: low likelihood (nobody sets VITEST by hand), but silent and it would have hidden real positions and muted alerts. Fixed before the bot was started.

evidence.note: the fix: VITEST set refuses before the lock
why the bug existed: the src-layer rails key on VITEST
RED before the fix, GREEN after; tests in test/unit/mainEntry.test.ts

sibling_sites_checked: Every VITEST read in src/: db.ts, notifier.ts, config.ts, main.ts. Scripts that load db.ts under a shell VITEST do not reach the signing path; preflight with VITEST set gets the temp DB and a failing report rather than a false pass.
recommendation: Done (5378478). src/main.ts refuses to start when VITEST is set, in the shell or in .env.
